verdict.rationale: Auth0's MFA docs list one-time passwords and recovery codes as supported factors, and describe MFA as a login-time requirement for additional credentials. Contextual enforcement is evidenced through Adaptive MFA, which prompts when a login seems risky, and Strong Customer Authentication for approving sensitive operations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one-time passwords mean TOTP authenticator apps, explicit step-up authentication docs (e.g., per-app or per-resource MFA via Actions or acr_values), detail on how admins require/enforce MFA tenant-wide, and independent hands-on corroboration.
